imageNote: Same finding as Lesson 1: docs.docker.com's Docker Concepts pages (what-is-an-image, etc.) were checked and confirmed to carry no embedded screenshots — text and code blocks only. All three images here come from Docker's own marketing site (www.docker.com/products and www.docker.com/blog), verified with curl -sL -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{content_type}' (200, image/png) before download, then viewed with the Read tool before captions were written.
